Under the banner of the TRIALSHOW.cz team and the MTB & TRIAL Mraveniště Říčany club, we are preparing the side programme at the FOR BIKES 2020 trade fair and our labour of love – and perpetually loss-making – event ŘÍČANSKÉ ŠLAPAČKY 2020, which this year will be a combination of races and a training camp.

We'll reveal the overall concept, programme, partners and disciplines once everything is fine-tuned in the coming months. Anyway, the date is set ...
